cards.name: 強勁

cards.name: 高聳

cards.name: 充飢
cards.scene: A hungry hiker sitting on a rock in the mountains eating a sandwich to fill the stomach, a backpack beside.

cards.name: 隱形

cards.name: 堅韌

cards.name: 虯鬚

cards.name: 繁茂

cards.name: 休止

cards.name: 蔓生

cards.name: 豐富

cards.name: 暗箭傷人

cards.name: 適可而止

cards.name: 羽毛未豐

cards.name: 俏皮
cards.scene: A playful little girl with two pigtails winking and sticking out her tongue cutely.

cards.name: 削鉛筆

cards.name: 銷售

cards.name: 消失

cards.name: 小徑

cards.name: 經過

cards.name: 安穩
cards.scene: A baby sleeping peacefully and safely in a cozy crib.

cards.name: 拉扯
cards.scene: Two children pulling a toy back and forth between them.

cards.name: 蛻變

cards.name: 正確
